mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy reduces corporate borrowing capacity and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in residential sales (RSAFS) indicates labor market strength supporting consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and RSAFS increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment rate signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1500, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates manufacturing contraction coupled with monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO decline and FEDFUNDS increase fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In low industrial production regimes (INDPRO < 95.0), a subsequent increase in INDPRO signals manufacturing recovery that boosts corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
